panel.tiptext: Specify taxon sets that make up species
Allows to specify date that a taxon was sampled
Site model and substitution model specifications

beauticonfig.partitiontemplate:
<geneTree id="geneTree.t:$(n)" ploidy="2.0" spec="starbeast2.GeneTree" populationModel="@popModelBridge.Species" speciesTree="@Tree.t:Species" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/>
<stateNode id="molecularClockRate.c:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/>
<!-- site model --> <plugin spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.sitemodel.SiteModel" id="SiteModel.s:$(n)" gammaCategoryCount="0"> <!--substModel will be automatically detected /--> <proportionInvariant id="proportionInvariant.s:$(n)" value="0.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="UnitInterval"/> <mutationRate id="mutationRate.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <shape id="gammaShape.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </plugin>
<plugin spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.likelihood.TreeLikelihood" id="treeLikelihood.$(n)"> <data idref="data"/> <tree idref="Tree.t:$(n)"/> <siteModel idref="SiteModel.s:$(n)"/> <branchRateModel id="SpeciesTreeRelaxedClock.c:$(n)" spec="starbeast2.StarBeastClock" geneTree="@geneTree.t:$(n)" clock.rate="@molecularClockRate.c:$(n)"> <speciesTreeRates spec="starbeast2.RandomLocalRates" id="branchRatesModel.Species" tree="@Tree.t:Species" rates="@branchRates.Species" indicators="@indicators.Species"/> </branchRateModel> </plugin>
<!-- tree and its properties --> <taxonset id="TaxonSet.$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.alignment.TaxonSet" alignment="@$(n)"/> <plugin spec="beast.base.evolution.tree.Tree" id="Tree.t:$(n)" taxonset="@TaxonSet.$(n)"/>
<plugin id="TreeHeight.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.tree.TreeStatLogger" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/>
<distribution id="MutationRatePrior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@mutationRate.s:$(n)"><M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="1.0"/><S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.0"/></distribution>
<distribution id="GammaShapePrior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@gammaShape.s:$(n)" meanInRealSpace="true" M="1.0" S="2.0"/>
<distribution id="PropInvariantPrior.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@proportionInvariant.s:$(n)" lower="0.0" upper="1.0"/>
<distribution id="molecularClockRatePrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@molecularClockRate.c:$(n)" meanInRealSpace="true"> <S id="molecularClockRatePriorStdev.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> <M id="molecularClockRatePriorMean.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>
<operator id="proportionInvariantScaler.s:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" parameter="@proportionInvariant.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="mutationRateScaler.s:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" parameter="@mutationRate.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="gammaShapeScaler.s:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" parameter="@gammaShape.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="molecularClockRateScaler.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="3.0" parameter="@molecularClockRate.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <upDownOperator id="clockUpDownOperator.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.UpDownOperator" scaleFactor="0.95" weight="3.0"> <down idref="Tree.t:$(n)"/> </upDownOperator>
<operator id="TreeScaler.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.95" weight="3.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.ScaleTreeOperator"/> <operator id="TreeRootScaler.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.7" weight="3.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" rootOnly="true" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.ScaleTreeOperator"/> <operator id="UniformOperator.t:$(n)" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.Uniform"/> <operator id="SubtreeSlide.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.kernel.BactrianSubtreeSlide" weight="15.0" size="0.002" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="Narrow.t:$(n)" spec="Exchange" isNarrow="true" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="Wide.t:$(n)" spec="Exchange" isNarrow="false" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="WilsonBalding.t:$(n)" spec="WilsonBalding" weight="15.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/>
<logger id="treelog.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.inference.Logger" logEvery="5000" fileName="$(tree).trees" mode="tree"> <log id="TreeWithMetaDataLogger.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.TreeWithMetaDataLogger" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> </logger>
Scale up substitution rate c:$(n) and scale down tree t:($n)
beauticonfig.subtemplate:
<stateNode id="morphClockRate.c:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/>
<distribution id="morphTreeLikelihood.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.likelihood.TreeLikelihood" tree="@Tree.t:Species"> <data spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.alignment.FilteredAlignment" id="$(n)" filter="0-end"> <userDataType spec="beast.base.evolution.datatype.StandardData" id="morphDataType.$(n)"/> </data> <siteModel spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.sitemodel.SiteModel" id="morphSiteModel.s:$(n)" gammaCategoryCount="0"> <substModel spec="morphmodels.evolution.substitutionmodel.LewisMK" id="LewisMK.s:$(n)" datatype="@morphDataType.$(n)"/> <mutationRate id="mutationRate.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <shape id="gammaShape.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </siteModel> <branchRateModel id="morphClock.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.branchratemodel.StrictClockModel" clock.rate="@morphClockRate.c:$(n)"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="MutationRatePrior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@mutationRate.s:$(n)"><M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="1.0"/><S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.0"/></distribution>
<distribution id="GammaShapePrior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@gammaShape.s:$(n)" meanInRealSpace="true" M="1.0" S="2.0"/>
<distribution id="morphClockRatePrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@morphClockRate.c:$(n)" meanInRealSpace="true"> <S id="morphClockRatePriorStdev.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> <M id="morphClockRatePriorMean.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>
<operator id="mutationRateScaler.s:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" parameter="@mutationRate.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="gammaShapeScaler.s:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" parameter="@gammaShape.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="morphClockRateScaler.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="3.0" parameter="@morphClockRate.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/>
